|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Darth Vader, Betrayer Of The Jedi]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published (3 September 2021). The current text is [[Darth Vader, Betrayer Of The Jedi (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source.
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 16 release; card image first published 3 September 2021<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/darthvaderbetrayerofthejedi.gif</code> as published 3 September 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/darthvaderbetrayerofthejedi.gif holotable commit b4a011a] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, if a lightsaber swung by Vader just 'hit' a character, character's game text is canceled (and if Amidala, she is immediately lost). While on Coruscant, adds one [Dark Side] icon here. Immune to [Set 3] Amidala and attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Darth Vader, Betrayer Of The Jedi (Errata)]]): Card image published 1 June 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/darthvaderbetrayerofthejedi.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/darthvaderbetrayerofthejedi.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, if a lightsaber swung by Vader just 'hit' a character, character's game text is canceled (and if Amidala, she is immediately lost). While on Coruscant, adds one [Dark Side] icon here. Immune to [Set 3] Amidala and attrition < 5.” The PC published pixel-identical copies of this image on 5 July 2022 (file format change only; no visible change). '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image only: the PC re-rendered the Virtual Set 16 card images (the side credit and copyright lines and the typesetting of the game text changed; on some cards icons or the set-icon position also changed); the game text words are the same. A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
